Dinning experience
Sep 2026 • Family
We visited the Vietnamese restaurant Cơm Niêu Thiên Lý, but unfortunately, our experience was disappointing.

Although we were very hungry, we ordered six dishes. Unfortunately, only the scrambled eggs and vegetables met our expectations. The chicken was dry and excessively salty, while the remaining dishes were of poor quality. Ultimately, we had to order additional food elsewhere.

The dining environment also detracted from the experience. We were seated in a small room on the second floor, next to the kitchen, where persistent odours from the kitchen made the atmosphere uncomfortable.

Based on our experience, we would not recommend this restaurant to tourists. There are many other Vietnamese restaurants that offer higher-quality food and a more pleasant dining environment. We would not return.

Tasted and experience
Sep 2026 • Family
We visited the Vietnamese restaurant Cơm Niêu Thiên Lý, and unfortunately, it was a very disappointing experience.

Even though we were extremely hungry, we ordered six dishes. Sadly, the only decent dishes were the simple scrambled eggs and vegetables. The chicken was dry and so overly salty, while the other dishes were simply terrible and far below our expectations.

To make matters worse, we were seated in a small room on the second floor, right next to the kitchen, where we could constantly smell unpleasant odours. It made the dining experience even more uncomfortable.

I would strongly advise tourists to avoid this restaurant. There are plenty of better Vietnamese restaurants where you can enjoy much better food and a more pleasant dining atmosphere. Based on our experience, we definitely would not return.End up we went back to apartment call for food order.
